note: Faults planted on purpose to test the testers (4t piece 8). Each is a small change to a copy of the game's source, in an area where our testing or he met a real fault before (the change itself is made up), so the testers are tested where the game has really gone wrong (after muPRL: faults drawn from real fault histories). 'old' must occur exactly once in 'file'. 'testers' names the machine testers that should catch it, each with the narrow run that is enough. Never applied to the game's own folder: plant.py works on a copy outside the repository. 'watch' names the checks (rule names, or feel number ids) the fault aims at: only a new failure there counts as caught, and only an unreached check there makes the fault not tested.
